meta.note: Paths are relative to games/halat/. Generated by tools/halat/build-media.mjs; merge into manifest.json. Audio: Ogg Vorbis 44.1 kHz, sfx mono / music stereo, loudness-normalised (sfx about -13..-18 LUFS, loops/music -18..-22); loudnessLUFS/peakDb measured with ffmpeg ebur128 (short sounds < 0.4 s read low). Sprites: PNG with alpha. Textures: tileable PNG, power-of-two.

fx_dust.tint: white/grey texture: multiply by material colour (SpriteMaterial.color) to tint (warm tan #c8a77a for dirt, brown for mud)
fx_dust.note: cartoon dust puff for feet / skids: puffy cloud, white with grey underside. Scale 0.6->1.4 and fade out over ~0.5 s. (game/assets fx_dust is a debris texture; this one fits the flat cartoon style better.)

fx_dust_sheet.tint: white/grey texture: multiply by material colour (SpriteMaterial.color) to tint
fx_dust_sheet.note: dust puff animation: pops out, expands, drifts up and dissolves (8 frames, play once at 16 fps). Same style as fx_dust.

fx_smoke.tint: white/grey texture: multiply by material colour (SpriteMaterial.color) to tint (grey #8a8a8a for tractor exhaust)
fx_smoke.note: soft exhaust smoke puff (blurry cloud). Spawn at the exhaust, rise, scale up 0.5->2, fade out.

fx_sweat.tint: none (coloured: light blue drop, dark blue outline, white highlight)
fx_sweat.note: single cartoon sweat drop. Spawn 1-3 near the head of straining pullers, fly out sideways and fall.

fx_strain_lines.tint: white strokes with dark outline: tint to red/orange for anger/effort
fx_strain_lines.note: comic effort / tension marks: 5 tapered strokes fanning upward from the bottom centre. Place above a puller's head (origin = bottom centre), pulse scale 0.9<->1.1 while straining.

fx_splash_sheet.tint: white/grey texture: multiply by material colour (SpriteMaterial.color) to tint (mud #6b4529, water #7cc8ff)
fx_splash_sheet.note: splash animation: crown of droplets thrown up and out, centre column rises and collapses, ground ring widens and fades. Origin = bottom centre (ground contact at y ~ 0.86 of the frame). Play once at 18 fps.

fx_mud_blob.tint: white/grey texture: multiply by material colour (SpriteMaterial.color) to tint (brown #6b4529 mud / blue for water drops)
fx_mud_blob.note: single splattered blob/droplet with two satellite drops; use as particle for mud/water spray and as a decal on characters.

fx_confetti.tint: white with light-grey fold shading: give every particle its own bright colour (instance colour)
fx_confetti.note: confetti piece atlas (NOT an animation): 0 rectangle, 1 circle, 2 squiggle, 3 star, 4 triangle, 5 curled ribbon, 6 diamond, 7 small rectangle strip. Pick a random cell per particle; spin by rotating and scaling X (cos(t)) for the flutter.

fx_sparkle.note: twinkle sparkle: 4-point star with long thin rays and a soft glow. Pulse scale and rotate slowly.

fx_star.tint: white/grey texture: multiply by material colour (SpriteMaterial.color) to tint (gold #ffd23f)
fx_star.note: chunky rounded cartoon 5-point star with bevel shading (score pops, dizzy stars, gift bursts).

fx_ring.note: shockwave ring with soft edges (giant step, gift landing, win). Scale 0.2->2 and fade out. Lay flat on the ground (rotate -90 deg X) or billboard.

fx_glow.note: soft radial glow blob (highlights, gift aura, sun glint).

fx_heart.tint: white/grey texture: multiply by material colour (SpriteMaterial.color) to tint (red/pink)
fx_heart.note: cartoon heart with bevel shading and a highlight (likes / taps).

fx_impact_star.tint: white burst with dark outline: tint yellow/orange
fx_impact_star.note: comic impact burst ("POW" star, 12 irregular spikes) for big hits, rope snap, giant steps. Show for 0.15-0.25 s with a scale pop.

tex_grass.repeat: about 1 tile per 2-3 m of ground (e.g. repeat 8x8 on a 20 m field)
tex_grass.note: stylised flat-painted lawn: posterised green patches, light/dark blade strokes, a few tiny white/yellow/pink flowers

tex_grass_normal.note: subtle tangent-space normal map matching tex_grass (normalScale 0.5-1)

tex_dirt.repeat: about 1 tile per 2 m of the arena lane
tex_dirt.note: packed sandy-brown arena dirt: posterised warm patches, shaded pebbles, faint scuffs

tex_mud.repeat: 1 tile per ~1.5-2 m of the mud pit
tex_mud.note: wet chocolate mud: domain-warped swirls, dark flat puddles with light rims, glossy glints. Use low roughness (0.35-0.5).

tex_mud_normal.repeat: same as tex_mud (scroll a second copy slowly for a "breathing" surface)
tex_mud_normal.note: normal map for tex_mud: swirly lumps, flat puddles

tex_water_normal.repeat: 2-4 tiles across the pool; scroll two copies in different directions (e.g. offset += (0.02,0.01)*t and (-0.015,0.02)*t) and blend
tex_water_normal.note: tileable soft wave normal map (sum of integer-frequency sine waves + fbm) for an animated water or mud surface

tex_rope.repeat: U along the rope length: repeat = ropeLength / (8 x ropeDiameter) (one tile = 18 strand twists, designed for a tile ~8 diameters long); V = 1 around the circumference (TubeGeometry UVs). Tileable in both U and V.
tex_rope.note: braided 3-strand hemp rope: diagonal strands with dark grooves and fibre streaks

tex_rope_normal.note: normal map for tex_rope (strand bulges, grooves, fibres)

tex_wood.repeat: one tile = 4 horizontal planks; map so a plank is ~0.25-0.3 m tall (fences, stands, stage)
tex_wood.note: warm cartoon wooden planks with grain rings, dark gaps, end seams, a few knots

tex_canvas_stripes.repeat: U: 1 tile = 2 stripe pairs (4 stripes of 64 px); repeat around a tent so stripes are ~0.5 m wide
tex_canvas_stripes.note: tent/banner canvas: vertical stripes white (255) and light grey (196) with a fine weave. Multiply-tint for single-colour stripes; for two-colour stripes (e.g. red/white) use the red channel as mask in a shader: mix(colB, colA, smoothstep(0.85, 0.95, tex.r)).

tex_sky_gradient.repeat: 1 (map V from horizon (bottom row) to zenith (top row) on a sky sphere / background plane)
tex_sky_gradient.note: sunny afternoon sky: deep blue zenith -> light blue -> pale warm horizon

crowd_loop.note: seamless fair crowd walla bed (lwdickens "county fair crowd walla", 30 s window, 2 s equal-power tail->head crossfade). Play quietly under everything.

crowd_cheer_a.note: crowd cheer swell, rises to a peak at ~3 s then fades (FoolBoyMedia "Crowd Cheer", first 6.5 s)

crowd_cheer_b.note: cheering + clapping crowd, sharp rise then natural decay (AlaskaRobotics "cheering and clapping crowd 1")

crowd_cheer_c.note: outdoor applause + whistles, shaped into a swell (kyles "applause cheer ... outdoor show", 7 s, 0.6 s fade-in, 2.5 s fade-out)

lose_aww.note: bigger disappointed crowd: three "aww/oh/groan" recordings layered with small offsets (phmiller42 + mrrap4food + CHallSmith)

grunt_m_1.note: male straining "nngh" (craigsmith "Man Straining", cut by RMS envelope at 5.7 s)

grunt_m_4.note: short pushing grunt (DeqstersLab "Grunting effort pushing" @ 0.76 s)

grunt_f_1.note: short female effort grunt (Nocturnal_Vanguard "Female Hurt Grunts & Groans" @ 3.7 s)

heave_team_b.note: crowd grunting in sync, one metered heave (ShangusBurger "Crowd Grunting, Exerting, Metered" @ 8.4 s); can be chained every ~1.35 s

strongman_roar.note: layered strongman effort roar: exertion groan pitched down 18% + straining layer pitched down 10% + low drum thump

rope_creak_a.note: mooring rope creak under load (Rmutt "Mooring Rope" @ 31.7 s)

rope_tension_loop.note: seamless rope-strain bed: rhythmic rope-friction creaks (Valerie-Vivegnis swing rope, exactly 12 periods of 1.4425 s) + 4 heavy mooring-rope creaks scattered with wrap-around. Fade its volume with rope tension.

rope_snap.note: synthesised rope snap: rising whoosh -> sharp noise crack + falling "thwip" chirp, layered with a wooden plank impact (Kenney)

whistle_start.note: referee double blast (two copies of Rosa-Orenes256 "Referee whistle sound", 0.1 s apart)

whistle_end.note: referee long blast: SpliceSound "Referee whistle blow, gymnasium" with its steady middle crossfade-extended to ~1.6 s, natural hall tail

drum_hit.note: big folk bass drum "DÜM" (Sassaby "Alfaia Hit", a Brazilian folk bass drum close to a davul) layered with a low kick (phluidbox)

drum_tek.note: light high "tek" stick/rim hit (Kenney impactWood_light, high-passed 350 Hz)

drum_roll.note: accelerating "tek" roll (16 hits, 0.12 s -> 0.035 s apart, crescendo) ending on a big DÜM; built from drum_tek + drum_hit

drum_loop.note: seamless davul pulling rhythm, 110 bpm, 4 bars of 4/4 (DÜM . tek tek DÜM . tek . | x3 + fill), tails wrap around. Sync heave animation to beats 1 and 3 (every 1.0909 s).

stinger_small.note: small gift: short pizzicato flourish + soft confirmation blip (Kenney Music Jingles PIZZI16 + Interface confirmation_001)

stinger_medium.note: medium gift: pizzicato jingle + punch + DÜM drum (Kenney PIZZI12 + impactPunch_medium_000 + drum_hit)

stinger_big.note: big gift: orchestral hit jingle + low boom + DÜM drum + bell (Kenney HIT15 + lowFrequency_explosion_000 + impactBell_heavy_001 + drum_hit)

tractor_loop.note: seamless diesel tractor idle (jmagiera "MB trac 1400 turbo running idle", 14 s window, loop length refined by waveform correlation, 0.6 s crossfade). Raise playbackRate (1.0-1.6) for revving.

tractor_start.note: tractor rev-up: the idle recording played with a variable-speed curve (0.7x crank -> 1.75x rev -> settles at 1.3x), ~2.8 s

giant_step.note: giant/heavy footstep: body impact + low sub boom + kick (Kenney impactPunch_heavy_000 + impactSoft_heavy_000 + lowFrequency_explosion_001 low-passed + phluidbox kick)

splash_mud.note: body falls into mud: wet splat + mud squelch + soft body thud (Breviceps "Mud Splat" + rubberduck mud_04 + Kenney impactSoft_heavy_001)

splash_water.note: big water splash (Thimras "Ocean splash") + small splash layer (rubberduck splash_01)

splash_small.note: small wet splash / droplet landing (rubberduck splash_06)

win_fanfare.note: victory fanfare, first phrase (RandomMind "Medieval: Victory Theme", 0-6.6 s, 0.7 s fade). Combine with crowd_cheer_* for the win moment.

countdown_beep.note: synthesised countdown beep, 880 Hz with 2nd/3rd harmonics, 0.18 s

countdown_go.note: synthesised "GO!" tone: one octave+fifth higher (1320 Hz) with octave-below body and slight vibrato, 0.6 s

join_pop.note: synthesised bubbly "pop" for a viewer joining: fast 320 -> 1150 Hz sine sweep with a click

music_fair.note: main music loop: RandomMind "Medieval: Market Day" (OGA CC0). The MP3 is a loop with encoder delay/padding: head trimmed at 1105 samples (LAME delay), tail at the last non-silent sample, 4 ms declick at the seam.

music_fair_b.note: alternative music loop: Bobjt "millennial fair" (OGA CC0, 90 s, more energetic). Leading/trailing codec silence trimmed, 4 ms declick at the seam.

font_display.note: bold rounded display font (titles, team names, big announcements, countdown); single weight 400. Contains Turkish glyphs (İ ı Ş ş Ğ ğ Ü ü Ö ö Ç ç).

font_text.note: rounded text font, VARIABLE weight 200-1000 (use @font-face font-weight: 200 1000). Contains Turkish glyphs.
